text:
sana: Kevin sent a short evidence ask for SOC2/ISO packet. Wants: (1) RBAC approval trail for prod service-accounts created since 2025-10-01, (2) KMS Decrypt samples for model keys, and (3) a brief CVE-2025-1122 triage summary + timeline. Can someone take ownership? :mag:

kevin_auditor: Hi team 1 For (1) we need the PR or ticket showing approval, the merged manifest diff, and the k8s audit create event (who created, who approved). For (2) raw CloudTrail Decrypt JSON entries with eventTime, requestParameters.keyId, userIdentity.principalId. IPs may be redacted but principalId and keyId must remain. For (3) a 2-3 sentence root-cause and a 4-step timeline with timestamps and links. Please deliver as a single zip with manifest.json mapping files to control IDs. Deadline: next Tue EOD.

ob: I can own RBAC. Plan: pick three random SA creations across infra-team repos, export PR diffs, and capture JIRA approval screenshots. Will also snapshot rolebindings and produce a CSV mapping SA->requester->approver->PR. I'll add a short separation-of-duties excerpt showing approver != author.

sana: Thanks. For k8s audit snippets please include the full JSON event for the create verb. Example jq I use: `jq -c 'select(.verb=="create" and .objectRef.resource=="serviceaccounts")' /var/log/k8s-audit/audit.log | grep 2025-10`

ops-eng: Reminder: when you stage artifacts put them under s3://redwood-evidence/staging/3267891234/ and include exceptions.txt listing any redactions beyond IPs. evidence-bundler will pick up the prefix.

ob: I'll push rbac artifacts to s3 when ready. Also adding a short policy snippet that limits who can both create and approve SAs.

sana: I'll take KMS. CLI I'll run: `aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=Decrypt --start-time 2025-10-01T00:00:00Z --end-time 2026-03-01T00:00:00Z --max-results 150 > decrypt-samples.json`. Then crosswalk principalId to k8s SA UIDs from ob's CSV.

log-bot: evidence-bundle job scheduled for prefix s3://redwood-evidence/staging/3267891234/ after artifacts present. Job ID: ev-3267891234. ETA 35m after upload.

ob: Uploaded rbac/pr-1567-diff.patch, rbac/jira-1567-approval.png, sa-mapping.csv, rbinding-snapshots.json to staging. Including `sa-proof.csv` with columns: serviceAccount,uid,requester,approver,pr.

sana: Uploaded kms/decrypt-samples.json and splunk-confirm.csv. I redacted sourceIPAddress values; left principalId and keyId intact. Added correlation_notes.txt listing any unmatched principalIds.

ops-eng: evidence bundle job started (ev-3267891234). Will place finished bundle at s3://redwood-evidence/finished/3267891234/evidence.zip.

sana: CVE draft summary for the packet: "2026-02-10 03:14 UTC: alert flagged surge in runtime errors. Triage found parsing bug in an open-source RPC library (affects header metadata parsing) present in dependency v1.49. Mitigation: temporary ingress filter to drop malformed headers, emergency bump to dependency v1.50.2 in runtime images, and added a regression test in CI to detect malformed metadata. No indicators of customer-data exfiltration." Timeline and PR/runbook links attached in triage-summary.md.

kevin_auditor: This is great. Two small asks: include keypolicy.md (rotation cadence + owners) and ensure manifest.json maps files to SOC2 control CC6 and ISO A.9 entries. Please DM the presigned URL when done.

ob: Will add keypolicy.md and manifest.json. exceptions.txt notes only IP redactions and a single internal-hostname redaction for a dev cluster.

sana: Sent presigned URL to Kevin via DM. Closing loop here unless auditor requests deeper logs. :white_check_mark:
